facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: The automated trace stays on the clicked layer and runs through 20 of 20 slices, but it cannot be trusted without manual checking. Only 45.6% lies within 5 voxels and 8.3% within 2 voxels, with a median distance of 5.3 voxels, which is only a modest improvement from 36.7% and 6.2 voxels before the fix. It is weakest away from the yellow dot, as seen where the red line drifts in the close-up and in slice 0 and slice 19 views. A person should check that the red line follows the same sheet and has not jumped to a neighbouring layer.
